notes.title: Demo Update - UI changes and Weather effects
notes.content: [p]The UI for drawing and playing cards has been reworked to look more like conventional cards. Cards have had several visual updates to make them more compact and consistent.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601395/4d7547e202b4dba8920c8a64e9a5ffd50f0e0242.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The day/night cycle is now much more apparent with more dramatic lighting and shadows.[/p][olist][*][p]The draw phase happens during the early morning when it is dark and foggy[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601395/89a71f1393d1351cd6012dca3af9e921b86bd9a1.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The player phase happens later in the morning when its a bit brighter.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601395/1daa766cd7247eb408f3618dc00d2450746668df.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The labor phase happens at midday. The fog has cleared and the sun is at its brightest. The four resource locations get their individual weather events.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601395/a30ace1c7de871ee43a1ce67028420985b429168.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]By peril phase the sun has nearly set.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601395/2ea0b056257d33db711955bb764906ea90c70935.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/olist]
